title: Leia Organa
description: LEIA ORGANA, a young princess and representative to the Imperial Senate from Alderaan, is a secret leader of the Rebel Alliance. Tortured, imprisoned and forced to watch the destruction of her adopted planet, Leia becomes more determined to help lead the Alliance to victory. She develops strong attachments to smuggler Han Solo and farm boy Luke Skywalker. The Force begins to stir in her too, since—unbeknownst to either—she is Luke's twin sister.
